1. Gossip Metadata Pricing: Advertise service rates in libp2p gossip metadata to enable zero-trust discovery without central directories.
2. Signed Event Logging: Automatically meter requests by appending cryptographic signatures to a local event log, creating immutable proof of work.
3. Receipt Fabric Billing: Bundle signed receipts into feeless XNO micro-payment batches settled via the P2P fabric, avoiding atomic cross-peer complexities.
4. Batch Settlement: Aggregate multiple small receipts into single batched payments to maximize throughput while maintaining individual auditability.
5. Deadbeat Cutoff: Enforce payment by instantly revoking access upon failed verification rather than pursuing unenforceable debt claims.
6. Competitive Discovery: Allow clients to compare price lists from multiple providers in real-time via gossip to drive market efficiency.
7. Dashboard Line Items: Display granular earnings per service type (relay, delegate, PoW) in the one-page UI for transparent accounting.
8. Utilization-Based Pricing: Dynamically adjust prices based on node load to optimize resource allocation and prevent congestion.
9. Pro-Maker Bundles: Offer tiered pricing packages bundling order book data and relay services, strictly excluding leveraged liquidity provision or oracle-dependent signals.
10. Time-Decay Integration: Incorporate explicit time-decaying option premiums into quote generation logic, allowing service income to reflect the diminishing value of stale market data.
methodology: Most people rely on centralized invoices; instead use signed receipt batches in feeless XNO micro-payments; because it enforces trustless settlement without custody.
baseline: Generic service billing mechanisms like simple metering and static pricing lists without specific integration into the Nano/XMR DEX architecture or consideration of the trustless, non-custodial constraints.
